sources.title: C11 draft: pointer/integer conversions and intptr_t/uintptr_t
sources.version_or_date: N1570 committee draft, April 12, 2011; catalogue-linked HTML mirror
sources.sections_read: Cover date; finds for sections 6.3.2.3 and 7.20.1.4
sources.confirmed: The draft specifies optional intptr_t/uintptr_t round trips for valid void pointers and implementation-dependent pointer/integer conversions.
sources.limits: The types are optional; their round-trip guarantee covers valid void pointers, while arbitrary address edits and resulting pointer validity remain implementation-dependent. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C23.json.

sources.title: Bit Twiddling Hacks: masked bit merging
sources.version_or_date: Live page; mask-merging entry explicitly dated February 9, 2006; whole live-page revision date unknown
sources.sections_read: Introduction; masked bit merging; power-of-two modulus sections
sources.confirmed: The source gives integer-mask merging and power-of-two remainder mechanisms; the mask-merging entry carries a February 9, 2006 attribution.
sources.limits: Applying it to addresses is a translation inference: tag bits must be available on the target ABI, and conversion back to a usable pointer needs a separate contract. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C23.json.
